scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The service company was used by Adrian's estate office.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: They arranged repairs before we moved in.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Was anyone supposed to keep access afterward?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Not that I knew. I was given keys, not a list of permissions.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Then we need the arrangement behind the repairs, not only the name on the van.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
